importPattern: Import `@rowan-ui/core/tokens` and a theme, then import each component from its package subpath. The subpath is the tag without the `rowan-` prefix: `<rowan-button>` is `@rowan-ui/core/button`, and that module registers the element. `import "@rowan-ui/core"` registers the full core catalog.

exceptions.note: Each glyph is its own module. `import "@rowan-ui/icons/elements/<name>"` registers `<rowan-icon>` and that name. `@rowan-ui/icons/element` registers the class only.
Install the `maplibre-gl` peer next to `@rowan-ui/maplibre`. The map registers from `@rowan-ui/maplibre/map`.

theming.summary: Rowan themes are CSS custom properties on `:root` or a `[data-theme]` scope. Primitive tokens feed semantic tokens, and component hooks follow the semantic layer. There is no JavaScript theme provider.

charts.summary: Buttons and navigation stay on the Rowan theme. The palette applies only inside the region that sets the attribute.

guidance: Import the base tokens and one shipped theme, then set data-theme on the scope that should change.
Product themes override semantic tokens (--rowan-color-bg, --rowan-color-fg, --rowan-color-accent, and the rest of that layer).
Shipped theme files re-declare component aliases so a nested [data-theme] scope resolves those aliases again.
CSS remains the runtime source of truth. @rowan-ui/core/tokens.json is a DTCG handoff for design tools.

<script type="module">
  import { applyFilters } from "@rowan-ui/core/filter-builder";

  const rows = [
    { id: "1", name: "Ada", role: "Admin" },
    { id: "2", name: "Alan", role: "Editor" },
  ];
  const table = document.querySelector("#members-table");
  const filters = document.querySelector("#member-filters");

  table.config = {
    rowId: "id",
    columns: [
      { id: "name", header: "Name" },
      { id: "role", header: "Role" },
    ],
    rows,
  };

  filters.fields = [
    { id: "name", label: "Name", operators: ["contains"] },
    { id: "role", label: "Role", options: ["Admin", "Editor"], operators: ["equals"] },
  ];

  filters.addEventListener("rowan-filter-change", (event) => {
    table.rows = applyFilters(rows, event.detail.filters, filters.fields);
  });
</script>

components.title: Table
components.description: Config-driven data table.

attributes.name: data-mode
attributes.description: `client` pages, sorts, and groups local rows. `server` asks `dataSource.getRows` instead. Default `client`.

attributes.name: edit-mode
attributes.description: `cell` edits one cell. `row` edits every editable cell in the row.

attributes.name: sort
attributes.description: JSON sort model. One `{"id","dir"}` object or an ordered array of those objects.

properties.name: columns
properties.description: Updates columns without replacing other configuration.

properties.name: config
properties.description: Replaces the complete table configuration.

properties.name: dataSource
properties.description: Server reads. `getRows({ page, pageSize, sort, filters, signal })` returns `{ rows, total }`. `sort` is an ordered array of `{ id, dir }`, or null. Optional `getChildren({ parentId, parent, sort, filters, signal })` returns `{ rows }` for one expanded parent and receives that same ordered `sort`. Optional `debounce` replaces the 200ms filter delay. Ignored when `data-mode` is `client`.

properties.name: externalLabelText
properties.description: Text of any `<label for>` bound to the host. `label`/`for` cannot cross a shadow boundary.

properties.name: filters
properties.description: Sent to `dataSource.getRows`. Quick filters are `{ id, value }`. A `rowan-filter-builder` tree (`{ field, operator, value }` leaves and `{ join, filters }` groups) is passed through intact. Assigning filters resets to the first page and is debounced. Client mode does not apply them unless `tree` is set, where `{ id, value }` filters keep ancestors of matches. The filter builder still evaluates its own tree. A column menu filter updates this list and fires `rowan-column-filter`.

properties.name: messages
properties.description: Property-only built-in message overrides.

properties.name: rows
properties.description: Updates rows without replacing other configuration.

properties.name: selected
properties.description: Updates selected row IDs without replacing other configuration.

properties.name: tree
properties.description: Hierarchical rows. Use `childrenField` (default `"children"`), `getChildren(row)`, or `parentField` for a flat parent id. `hasChildren(row)` marks a server row that can load children. `expanded` is the initial open row ids. `defaultExpanded` opens every loaded parent. `groupBy` is ignored while a tree is set. Pagination slices root rows; expanded children stay with their parent. Sibling sort follows the ordered `sort` array. Column menu actions apply to these columns.

properties.name: virtualItemSize
properties.description: Estimated row height used before a row is measured.

properties.name: virtualized
properties.description: Renders a measured, bounded row window inside the table viewport.

properties.name: virtualOverscan
properties.description: Extra rows mounted before and after the visible window.

events.name: rowan-cell-action
events.description: Fired when a link or button cell activates. Cancelable; preventDefault on a link action to block navigation.

events.name: rowan-cell-bind
events.description: Fired once for each cloned custom slot cell

events.name: rowan-cell-change
events.description: Fired when checkbox cell value changes

events.name: rowan-column-filter
events.description: Fired from a column menu filter field. Cancelable. `detail` is `{ columnId, value }`. `preventDefault()` leaves `filters` unchanged.

events.name: rowan-column-reorder
events.description: Fired when columns are reordered. `detail` contains fromIndex, toIndex, and columns array.

events.name: rowan-column-resize
events.description: Fired when a column is resized. `detail` contains columnId, width, and columns array.

events.name: rowan-copy
events.description: Fired before a clipboard write. Cancelable. `detail.text` is TSV and `detail.html` is an HTML table. Listeners may replace either, or `detail.rows`.

events.name: rowan-data-error
events.description: Fired when `getRows` rejects. `detail.error` is the Error. The error row offers retry.

events.name: rowan-data-load
events.description: Fired after `getRows` resolves. `detail` includes `rows`, `total`, and the query.

events.name: rowan-data-request
events.description: Fired before a server read. Cancelable. `detail` is `{ page, pageSize, sort, filters }`. `preventDefault()` skips the request.

events.name: rowan-edit-cancel
events.description: Fired when a cell edit is discarded.

events.name: rowan-edit-commit
events.description: Fired when a cell value is accepted. Cancelable.

events.name: rowan-edit-start
events.description: Fired before a cell editor opens. Cancelable.

events.name: rowan-edit-validate
events.description: Fired before a cell or row commit, after `required` and `validate`. Cancelable. `preventDefault()` keeps the editor open. Not part of the commit event, so a rejected value is never delivered to commit listeners. `detail.message` is the error text; listeners may replace it.

events.name: rowan-export
events.description: Fired before a CSV or Excel download. Cancelable. `detail` includes `format`, `filename`, `header`, `rows`, and `truncated`. Listeners may replace `filename` or `rows`.

events.name: rowan-group-toggle
events.description: Fired when a group header is expanded or collapsed by the user

events.name: rowan-page-change
events.description: Fired when pagination changes. `detail.index` is 0-based; `detail.page` is 1-based.

events.name: rowan-paste
events.description: Fired before pasted cells are validated. Cancelable. `detail` includes the start cell, the TSV matrix, and `targets`. Listeners may change `targets` or call `preventDefault()`.

events.name: rowan-paste-result
events.description: Fired after a paste. `detail.applied` and `detail.rejected` list the cells, with `message` on rejects. `detail.ignored` counts values that did not fit.

events.name: rowan-row-activate
events.description: Fired on row activation by keyboard or double click. Not fired from interactive cells, and not fired when `rowActivate` is `none`.

events.name: rowan-row-edit-cancel
events.description: Fired when a row edit is discarded.

events.name: rowan-row-edit-commit
events.description: Fired when every editable cell in a row is valid. Cancelable. `detail.values` and `detail.oldValues` are keyed by column id.

events.name: rowan-select
events.description: Fired when row selection changes

events.name: rowan-sort
events.description: Fired when a sortable header changes direction. `detail` is the changed `{ id, dir }`.

events.name: rowan-sort-change
events.description: Fired when the user changes the sort. `detail.sort` is the full ordered array of `{ id, dir }`.

events.name: rowan-tree-toggle
events.description: Fired when a tree row expands or collapses. `detail` is `{ rowId, expanded, row }`.

slots.name: toolbar
slots.description: View controls. Shares the table's outer chrome; nested cards drop their own border.

methods.name: copyToClipboard
methods.description: Copy selected rows, or the focused cell when nothing is selected, as TSV and an HTML table.

methods.name: expandAll
methods.description: Opens every loaded tree parent. Child fetches run when a row has no local children.

methods.name: exportCsv
methods.description: Download a CSV file. In server mode the loaded page is exported unless `getRows` supplies the full set.

methods.name: exportExcel
methods.description: Download a real .xlsx workbook. Options match `exportCsv`.

methods.name: pasteText
